description: The lowest component that contains every reader of a piece of state. Lifting stops there.
Keeping state as close as possible to where it is used, often by moving it down into a new component.
Passing subtrees as `children` or slot props so they are created by a parent that does not re-render.
A prop that receives JSX (`header`, `sidebar`), letting the owner render leaves directly and avoiding prop drilling.
A component that receives its value and change callback from its parent instead of owning the state.
